Hi there,

I'm really excited about this project and I think the 1969 Brightwater Corsair would be perfect for a period drama shoot. We'll be picking it up on 29th September 2027 at 14:30 and bringing it back on Friday 1 October 2027 at 9:00 am. We'll be collecting it from your garage. I've attached my driving licence.

Cheers,
Elsie Marrowby
